title: Former Shu
capsule: Former Shu (Qian Shu) was one of the Ten Kingdoms of the Five Dynasties period, founded by Wang Jian in the Sichuan basin in 907 after the Tang dynasty's collapse. Wang built an elaborate court culture at Chengdu and briefly extended control into the Hanzhong region and parts of Gansu, styling himself emperor. His successor Wang Yan proved an indolent ruler, and in 925 a Later Tang expedition under Guo Chongtao and Li Jipeng conquered the kingdom in a swift campaign, ending Former Shu after only eighteen years.
attestation: Boundaries from Seshat Cliopatria (Bennett et al., Scientific Data 2025; CC BY 4.0), digitized from standard historical atlases at ~0.07° resolution. Former Shu's territory in the Sichuan basin is clearly delimited by geography and documented in the Zizhi Tongjian; peripheral border territories remain less precisely mapped.
